name: 金融时报
description: 源自 rico-md 的「金融时报」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 16px 40px 16px; font-family: Georgia, Songti SC, Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8; color: {{text}}; background-color: #fff2e8; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.3; margin: 28px 0 16px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; border-bottom: 3px solid {{codeText}}; padding-bottom: 10px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.45; margin: 18px 0 8px; font-variant: small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.03em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

paragraph.html: {{content}}

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{codeText}}; color: {{codeBg}}; padding: 9px 14px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 28px auto; border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #e0d8ce; max-width: 60px">
